guarantees.claim: On reset (rst_ni low), break_st_q is set to BRK_CHK.
When in BRK_CHK state and event_rx_break_err is asserted, break_st_q transitions to BRK_WAIT on the next clock edge.
When in BRK_WAIT state and rx_in is high, break_st_q transitions to BRK_CHK.
For any state not explicitly handled (including unreachable or corrupted states), break_st_q is forced to BRK_CHK.

assumptions.claim: event_rx_break_err is correctly generated by upstream logic to indicate a valid break condition on the receive line.
assumptions.risk: Missing or spurious event_rx_break_err causes incorrect break detection or state hang.

assumptions.claim: rx_in is a clean, synchronized digital signal reflecting the serial line, going high to signal end of break condition.
assumptions.risk: Glitches or incorrect line recovery cause premature or stuck exit from break wait, affecting subsequent break detection.

uncertain_points.claim: While in BRK_WAIT, any new event_rx_break_err assertion is ignored; it is unclear if break events should be suppressed during recovery.
uncertain_points.risk: Missed break detection if a new break occurs before rx_in recovers.

uncertain_points.claim: rx_in is used level-sensitive without internal synchronization; its timing and metastability protection must be ensured outside this block.
uncertain_points.risk: Metastable sampling could cause incorrect state transitions.
